effects: Pulls exactly `assets` WETH from the signer into the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
Mints vault shares (kpk_ETH_YieldV2) to `onBehalf`. The share count is computed on-chain by previewDeposit after interest and fee accrual.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.001 WETH for <onBehalf>, with fields for the WETH amount, a constant share ticker "KPK_ETH_Yield" and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to onBehalf is computed on-chain and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. Shares depend on _totalAssets and the fee accrual in storage. No minimum-shares parameter exists.

findings.title: deposit: the constant ticker 'KPK_ETH_Yield' differs from the on-chain share symbol kpk_ETH_YieldV2.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "KPK_ETH_Yield". Case 0 mint effect symbol "kpk_ETH_YieldV2". The underlying Morpho vault 0xc88e... is "kpk_ETH_Yield_Morpho", so similar names exist.
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to "kpk_ETH_YieldV2", or use a name that clearly identifies the V2 vault.

findings.title: deposit: interpolatedIntent names neither the vault nor the shares; 'for <addr>' does not say shares go there.
findings.evidence: interpolatedIntent "Deposit {#.assets} for {#.onBehalf}". Case 0 renders "Deposit 0.001 WETH for 0x...dEaD".
findings.fix: Use "Deposit {#.assets} into KPK ETH Yield, shares to {#.onBehalf}".

cases.notes: The 0.001 WETH outflow is shown exactly. Shares are minted to 0xdead (signer null). The screen shows that recipient and the reader understood it.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns vault shares from `onBehalf`. The count is computed by previewWithdraw (rounded up), with no maximum-shares bound.
Sends exactly `assets` WETH from the vault to `receiver`.
When the signer is not `onBehalf`, spends the signer's share allowance from `onBehalf` by the number of shares burned.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly <assets> WETH to <receiver>, with Owner = <onBehalf> as a field.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is computed on-chain and never mentioned on screen.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)`. exit calls `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 1: 49787645272633478 kpk_ETH_YieldV2 leave the signer. The screen has no share field and no shares wording.
findings.fix: Optionally relabel Owner as "Shares burned from" so that it says shares leave this account. The amount cannot be shown.

findings.title: withdraw: no maximum-shares bound exists, so the shares spent depend on the vault's share price at execution.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw takes only assets, receiver and onBehalf. Shares come from previewWithdraw using storage values.

cases.notes: The 0.05 WETH inflow to the signer is shown exactly. The burn of 0.0497876 kpk_ETH_YieldV2 shares is not quantified. The reader knew shares leave but not how many.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `onBehalf`. When the signer is not onBehalf, this spends the signer's share allowance.
Sends WETH to `receiver`. The amount is computed by previewRedeem from storage, with no minimum bound.
formats.shown: Redeem <shares> KPK_ETH_Yield to <receiver>, with Owner = <onBehalf>. Nothing says what asset arrives.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says WETH is received; the reader could not tell which asset arrives.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` with asset = WETH. The descriptor redeem fields are shares, receiver and onBehalf only. Case 2: 14.98 WETH in to the signer. The reader's 'unsure' says "Which asset I receive (ETH, WETH, or other) and the amount".
findings.fix: Add a constant field such as {"label":"Receive asset","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker","format":"raw"} and use the intent "Redeem {#.shares} for WETH to {#.receiver}".

findings.title: redeem: the WETH amount received is computed on-chain with no minimum, so it cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. No minAssets parameter exists.

cases.notes: The share burn of 14.938906018365095009 is shown exactly. The 14.98 WETH inflow has no asset or amount on screen. The reader knew something arrives at their address but not what.
